name: hud_ui_options_panel_effects_sync_from_options
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_Effects::SyncFromOptions advances the effects selector and stores the selected index in the current hardware-mode effects option.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40cb70 calls HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::AdvanceSelectionAndActivate, then passes self->selectedIndex to zOpt::SetEffectsLevelForCurrentHwMode, and returns.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_effects_sync_from_options_smoke verifies cycle advance, wrap to first index, software/hardware EffectsLevel storage, and the conditional-effect level side effect produced by SetEffectsLevelForCurrentHwMode.
